subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should this PR become the single canonical fix for the crash-loop SecretRef regression instead of the competing open PR?
rationale: Both branches target the same P0 regression and now preserve reload source state, but only one implementation should define the Gateway startup and recovery contract.

options.title: Select This PR
options.body: Refresh and land this narrower implementation that uses the existing runtime snapshot API, then close the competing PR as superseded.

options.title: Select Competing PR
options.body: Close this PR and proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 only after confirming equivalent exact-head proof and the same bounded source/reload semantics.

options.title: Request Consolidation
options.body: Pause both branches and ask a Gateway owner for one replacement patch if neither ownership shape is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Select This PR
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this narrower implementation that uses the existing runtime snapshot API, then close the competing PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit history directly connects this person to the breaker contract whose recovery semantics require a canonical implementation choice.
